# Costco Supplier Meeting Prep

## Executive Summary
Costco publishes vendor contact paths for prospective suppliers. [claim_vendor_routing]

## Context for Meeting
This sentence cites a stale claim ID that is not in the final evidence ledger. [claim_stale]

## What We Know
- Costco publishes vendor contact paths for prospective suppliers. [claim_vendor_routing]

## What We Do Not Know
- The stale claim ID has no evidence-ledger support.

## Supplier/Buyer Angle
Treat unsupported claim IDs as a publication blocker.

## Questions to Ask
- Which buying office and category should the supplier prepare for? [claim_vendor_routing]

## Risks and Watchouts
- Reports must not restore dropped or stale claim IDs.

## Evidence Limitations
- This traceability fixture intentionally includes one unknown claim ID.
